datasets.name: ACNE04
datasets.role: box-level lesion detector baseline and historical comparison
datasets.size: 1457 face images; 18983 source-author boxes in the reviewed mirror
datasets.license_status: academic/research use only; not for commercial deployment without author permission

datasets.name: AcneSCU
datasets.role: fine-grained lesion detection/instance segmentation research after access and license verification
datasets.size: 276 images; 31777 instance-level annotations reported by the paper
datasets.license_status: verify original distribution terms before download or use; third-party mirror labels are not sufficient proof
limits: do not assume a third-party mirror preserves patient IDs or original terms

datasets.name: SCIN
datasets.role: external diversity and gradability evaluation, not acne-box training
datasets.license_status: custom SCIN Data Use License; attribution and no re-identification requirements

datasets.name: CHROMA-FIT
datasets.role: skin-tone measurement research and colour error analysis
datasets.license_status: verify dataset terms before training; use primarily as colour-ground-truth evaluation
limits: DSLR indoor/outdoor capture differs from phone app capture

rule: No internet image scraping. Every image must have provenance, permitted purpose, consent/license record, and subject/date/device grouping before ingestion.
